targets.rawQueryText:
-- raw up to 2 days, agg_15min beyond, one value per (CET) day beyond 60 days
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
src AS (
  SELECT CASE v.name WHEN 'SOLAR_POWER_W' THEN 'Solar' WHEN 'BAT_POWER_W' THEN 'Battery' WHEN 'LOAD_W' THEN 'Load' ELSE v.name END AS name, x.ts, x.value, max(q.i, v.log_s) AS b
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN raw x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('SOLAR_POWER_W', 'BAT_POWER_W', 'LOAD_W') AND q.t - q.f <= 172800
  UNION ALL
  SELECT CASE v.name WHEN 'SOLAR_POWER_W' THEN 'Solar' WHEN 'BAT_POWER_W' THEN 'Battery' WHEN 'LOAD_W' THEN 'Load' ELSE v.name END AS name, x.ts, x.value, CASE WHEN q.t - q.f > 5184000 THEN 86400 ELSE max(q.i, 900) END
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('SOLAR_POWER_W', 'BAT_POWER_W', 'LOAD_W') AND q.t - q.f > 172800
)
SELECT CASE WHEN b >= 86400 THEN ts - (ts + 3600) % 86400 ELSE ts - ts % b END AS time, name, AVG(value) AS value
FROM src
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Energy per day (last 30 days)
panels.description: Production = PV house + workshop, consumption = load house + workshop (DC side). Balance (click it in the legend) = production - consumption. Today is incomplete.

targets.rawQueryText:
-- kWh per local day: counters = SUM of the 15 min increments, powers (_W) = SUM of the 15 min means / 4
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
p AS (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', date(x.ts, 'unixepoch', 'localtime'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS d,
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.name = 'LLOAD1_CONS_WH' THEN x.value END), 0) AS "LLOAD1_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.name = 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH' THEN x.value END), 0) AS "LLOAD2_CONS_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.name = 'LPV1_PROD_WH' THEN x.value END), 0) AS "LPV1_PROD_WH",
    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.name = 'LPV2_PROD_WH' THEN x.value END), 0) AS "LPV2_PROD_WH"
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= CAST(strftime('%s', date(q.f, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '+1 day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('LLOAD1_CONS_WH', 'LLOAD2_CONS_WH', 'LPV1_PROD_WH', 'LPV2_PROD_WH')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT substr('JanFebMarAprMayJunJulAugSepOctNovDec', CAST(strftime('%m', d, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) * 3 - 2, 3) || ' ' || CAST(strftime('%d', d, 'unixepoch', 'localtime') AS INTEGER) AS day,
       ("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Production",
       ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Consumption",
       (("LPV1_PROD_WH" + "LPV2_PROD_WH") - ("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH")) / 1000.0 AS "Balance"
FROM p
ORDER BY d

panels.description: Consumption split into loads; the stack adds up to the Consumption bar of Energy per day. Workshop = Axpert output - EV charger. Axpert losses = Axpert DC input - AC output (rough). Other = consumption - all of the above (lights, DC loads, inverter losses, kids room + office, measurement errors; can be negative).

    COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN v.name = 'CONS_TECHM_WH' THEN x.value END), 0) AS "CONS_TECHM_WH",

       ("CONS_TECHM_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Technical room",
       ("CONS_OTHER_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Other circuits",
       ("CONS_AXPERT_WH" - "CONS_EVSE_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Workshop",
       ("CONS_EVSE_WH") / 1000.0 AS "EV charger",
       ("CONS_WS_HEATING_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Workshop air conditioner",
       ("EL_HEATER_CONS_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Water heater",
       ("AXPERT_LOAD_W" - "CONS_AXPERT_WH") / 1000.0 AS "Axpert losses",
       (("LLOAD1_CONS_WH" + "LLOAD2_CONS_WH") - ("CONS_FRIDGE_WH") - ("CONS_KITCHEN_WH") - ("CONS_WASCHMACHINE_WH") - ("CONS_TECHM_WH") - ("CONS_OTHER_WH") - ("CONS_AXPERT_WH" - "CONS_EVSE_WH") - ("CONS_EVSE_WH") - ("CONS_WS_HEATING_WH") - ("EL_HEATER_CONS_WH") - ("AXPERT_LOAD_W" - "CONS_AXPERT_WH")) / 1000.0 AS "Other"

panels.title: Loads power
panels.description: Stacked: the top is the total load (LOAD_W). Same categories as Loads per day. Other = load - all categories; noisy, the sources refresh at different rates.

targets.rawQueryText:
-- computed from the bucket means (raw up to 2 days, agg_15min beyond)
WITH q AS (SELECT $__from / 1000 AS f, $__to / 1000 AS t, $__interval_ms / 1000 AS i),
src AS (
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, max(q.i, 60) AS b
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN raw x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('AXPERT_LOAD_W', 'EL_HEATER_CURRENT_A', 'LOAD_W', 'POW_AXPERT_W', 'POW_EVSE_W', 'POW_FRIDGE_W', 'POW_KITCHEN_W', 'POW_OTHER_W', 'POW_TECHM_W', 'POW_WASCHMACHINE_W', 'POW_WS_HEATING_W', 'STRG1_VOLTAGE_V') AND q.t - q.f <= 172800
  UNION ALL
  SELECT v.name, x.ts, x.value, CASE WHEN q.t - q.f > 5184000 THEN 86400 ELSE max(q.i, 900) END
  FROM q, vars v CROSS JOIN agg_15min x ON x.var_id = v.id AND x.ts >= q.f AND x.ts < q.t
  WHERE v.name IN ('AXPERT_LOAD_W', 'EL_HEATER_CURRENT_A', 'LOAD_W', 'POW_AXPERT_W', 'POW_EVSE_W', 'POW_FRIDGE_W', 'POW_KITCHEN_W', 'POW_OTHER_W', 'POW_TECHM_W', 'POW_WASCHMACHINE_W', 'POW_WS_HEATING_W', 'STRG1_VOLTAGE_V') AND q.t - q.f > 172800
),
p AS (
